papers.title: Gut mycobiome dysbiosis in inflammatory bowel disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The intestinal mycobiome is increasingly recognized as an important component of host-microbiota interactions in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), yet its contribution to intestinal immune dysregulation remains incompletely characterized. We aimed to characterize alterations in the intestinal mycobiome in patients with inflammatory bowel disease, including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, compared with individuals without IBD, focusing on fungal diversity, taxonomic composition, and relative abundance, as well as their potential associations with disease phenotype and inflammatory activity.
METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines. PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were systematically searched from inception to March 2026, with no language or publication-date restrictions. The review was not prospectively registered. Human studies assessing gut fungal communities by internal transcribed spacer (ITS)-based sequencing or shotgun metagenomics were eligible. Alpha and beta diversity, taxonomic composition, and clinically relevant fungal alterations were extracted. Study quality was assessed independently by two reviewers using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS), and quantitative analyses were performed using standardized effect estimates and pooled prevalence.
RESULTS: Twenty-eight studies were included in the qualitative and quantitative synthesis. CD was consistently associated with reduced fungal alpha diversity compared with healthy controls, with a pooled weighted mean difference in Shannon diversity of -0.84 (p<0.001), whereas the reduction in UC was more modest (-0.31, p=0.04). Fungal beta diversity consistently differed between IBD and healthy controls. Expansion of Candida spp. was the most reproducible taxonomic alteration, occurring in 82.1% of analyzed cohorts, while depletion of Saccharomyces cerevisiae was reported in 71.4%. Malassezia enrichment was also associated with mucosal inflammation and CARD9-related immune responses. Cross-kingdom interactions involving Candida, Escherichia coli, and Serratia marcescens further highlighted potential fungal-bacterial mechanisms underlying persistent inflammation. Persistent fungal dysbiosis despite clinical remission supported the concept of a "mycobiotic scar."
CONCLUSION: IBD is characterized by substantial disruption of the intestinal mycobiome, particularly in CD, with reduced fungal diversity, expansion of potentially pathogenic Candida spp., and depletion of protective fungal taxa. These alterations may contribute to immune dysregulation and therapeutic refractoriness and support the mycobiome as a potential source of biomarkers and therapeutic targets in IBD.

papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病中的腸道真菌相失衡：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：腸道真菌相日益被認為是發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）中宿主與微生物相交互作用的重要組成部分，但其對腸道免疫失調的影響仍未完全釐清。本研究旨在比較IBD患者，包括克隆氏症（CD）與潰瘍性結腸炎（UC），與非IBD個體的腸道真菌相變化，重點涵蓋真菌多樣性、分類組成及相對豐度，以及這些變化與疾病表型及發炎活性的潛在關聯。
方法：依據PRISMA 2020指引進行系統性回顧與統合分析。系統性檢索PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase及Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials，檢索範圍自各資料庫建置起至2026年3月，不限制語言或發表日期。本回顧未進行前瞻性註冊。納入使用內轉錄間隔區（ITS）定序或鳥槍式宏基因體定序評估腸道真菌群落的人體研究。擷取α與β多樣性、分類組成及具臨床相關性的真菌變化。兩名審查者使用Newcastle-Ottawa Scale（NOS）獨立評估研究品質，並使用標準化效應估計值及合併盛行率進行定量分析。
結果：共28項研究納入定性與定量整合。相較於健康對照者，CD一致與較低的真菌α多樣性相關，Shannon多樣性指數的合併加權平均差為−0.84（p<0.001）；UC的下降幅度則較小（−0.31，p=0.04）。IBD患者與健康對照者的真菌β多樣性一致存在差異。Candida屬真菌增加是最具一致性的分類群變化，出現在82.1%的分析世代中；71.4%的分析世代則報告Saccharomyces cerevisiae減少。Malassezia增加亦與黏膜發炎及CARD9相關免疫反應有關。涉及Candida、Escherichia coli及Serratia marcescens的跨界交互作用，進一步凸顯可能造成持續發炎的真菌與細菌作用機制。即使達到臨床緩解，真菌相失衡仍持續存在，支持「真菌相疤痕」的概念。
結論：IBD的特徵包括腸道真菌相顯著紊亂，尤其在CD更為明顯，表現為真菌多樣性降低、具潛在致病性的Candida屬真菌增加，以及具保護作用的真菌分類群減少。這些變化可能促成免疫失調與治療難治性，並支持將真菌相視為IBD生物標記及治療標的的潛在來源。
papers.score_reason: 彙整28項研究並提供多樣性的定量結果，但未前瞻性註冊，摘要也未提供信賴區間、異質性與研究品質結果。對IBD機轉研究有參考價值，尚不足以改變台灣大腸直腸外科的檢查或治療決策。
papers.relevance_why: 涉及外科常見的IBD族群，但聚焦真菌相關聯，未評估手術、術後併發症或可直接採用的治療策略。

papers.title: Survival Outcomes in Metastatic Colorectal Cancer Patients with BRAF Mutations Undergoing Targeted Chemotherapy: A Reconstructed Individual Patient Data Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
papers.authors: Kazmi S, Rehman M, Tariq H, Kabir A, Ahmed J, Yee N
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) represents an aggressive molecular subtype associated with poor prognosis and limited response to conventional chemotherapy. Although multiple targeted strategies, including anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), anti-epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), and BRAF-directed therapies, are used in clinical practice, their comparative effectiveness remains uncertain. We performed a reconstructed individual patient-data (IPD) meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) to evaluate survival outcomes across targeted therapeutic classes in BRAF-mutant mCRC.
METHODS: A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Cochrane databases was conducted through July 2025 to identify RCTs reporting survival outcomes for BRAF-mutant mCRC. Kaplan-Meier curves were digitized and IPD reconstructed using established methods. A one-stage meta-analysis using Cox proportional hazards models was performed to estimate pooled overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS). Models were adjusted for study-level covariates and clustering, with Bonferroni correction applied for multiple comparisons.
RESULTS: Eighteen RCTs comprising 11,931 participants were included. Pooled median OS was 22.3 months for BRAF-directed regimens, 17.1 months for VEGF-targeted therapy, and 10.1 months for EGFR-directed therapy across studies evaluating first-line therapy. Across first-line studies, BRAF inhibitor directed regimen was associated with significantly improved OS compared with EGFR inhibition (HR 0.43, 95% CI 0.31-0.60; P < 0.001) and improved PFS (HR 0.47, 95% CI 0.42-0.53; P < 0.001). VEGF inhibition also demonstrated superior OS compared with EGFR inhibition (HR 0.56, 95% CI 0.38-0.81; p < 0.001). EGFR-directed regimen consistently demonstrated the poorest survival outcomes across analyses.
DISCUSSION: In this reconstructed IPD meta-analysis, BRAF-directed therapies were associated with the most favourable survival outcomes, whereas EGFR directed regimen demonstrated limited clinical benefit in BRAF-mutant mCRC. These results highlight the importance of biologically aligned pathway-targeted therapy and provide comparative evidence to inform treatment selection in this aggressive molecular subtype.

papers.title_zh: 接受標靶化學治療之BRAF突變轉移性大腸直腸癌病人的存活結果：隨機對照試驗之重建個別病人資料統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：BRAF V600E突變之轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）是一種侵襲性分子亞型，預後不佳，且對傳統化學治療的反應有限。雖然臨床實務已使用多種標靶策略，包括抗血管內皮生長因子（VEGF）、抗表皮生長因子受體（EGFR）及針對BRAF的治療，但其比較療效仍不確定。我們進行隨機對照試驗（RCT）的重建個別病人資料（IPD）統合分析，評估BRAF突變mCRC中不同標靶治療類別的存活結果。
方法：系統性搜尋PubMed、Embase、Scopus及Cochrane資料庫，搜尋截至2025年7月，以找出報告BRAF突變mCRC存活結果的RCT。將Kaplan–Meier曲線數位化，並以既定方法重建IPD。使用Cox比例風險模型進行單階段統合分析，以估計合併整體存活期（OS）及無惡化存活期（PFS）。模型針對研究層級共變項及群聚效應進行調整，並以Bonferroni校正處理多重比較。
結果：納入18項RCT，共11,931名參與者。在評估第一線治療的研究中，BRAF標靶方案、VEGF標靶治療及EGFR標靶治療的合併OS中位數分別為22.3、17.1及10.1個月。在第一線治療研究中，與EGFR抑制治療相比，BRAF抑制劑標靶方案與顯著改善的OS（HR 0.43，95% CI 0.31–0.60；P < 0.001）及PFS（HR 0.47，95% CI 0.42–0.53；P < 0.001）相關。相較於EGFR抑制治療，VEGF抑制治療也顯示較佳OS（HR 0.56，95% CI 0.38–0.81；p < 0.001）。在各項分析中，EGFR標靶方案均呈現最差的存活結果。
討論：在此重建IPD統合分析中，BRAF標靶治療與最有利的存活結果相關，而EGFR標靶方案在BRAF突變mCRC中的臨床效益有限。這些結果凸顯採用符合腫瘤生物學之訊息傳遞路徑標靶治療的重要性，並提供比較性證據，協助此侵襲性分子亞型的治療選擇。

papers.title: Cancer risk among individuals with mental illness - a systematic review and meta-analysis of nordic register-based prospective studies
papers.authors: Xiao X, Sadeghi F, Murphy G, Zhang Z, Andreassen O, Valdimarsdóttir U
papers.abstract: Although cancer patients have a high burden of mental illness, it is less clear whether patients with mental illness experience a higher-than-expected cancer risk. This systematic review investigated the associations between a wide range of types of mental illness and subsequent cancer risk. Five electronic databases were searched for articles published from database initiation to October 24, 2024. Studies using nationwide Nordic register data to conduct a prospective analysis of the association between mental illness diagnosis and cancer incidence were included. When data from three or more countries were available for a given type of mental illness, random effects meta-analyses were performed; otherwise, narrative syntheses were conducted. A total of 7,767 non-duplicate articles were screened, of which 20 were included. Meta-analyses showed no association between schizophrenia diagnosis and overall cancer risk; however, a high level of heterogeneity was detected between studies. Individuals with schizophrenia appeared to have a higher risk of breast cancer (pooled standardized incidence ratio [SIR]: 1.28, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.08-1.52), and lower risks of rectal cancer (pooled SIR: 0.75, 95% CI: 0.59-0.95) and prostate cancer (pooled SIR: 0.53, 95% CI: 0.48-0.59), compared to individuals in the general population. A higher risk of overall cancer was observed for mood, anxiety, and stress-related disorders, as well as autism and intellectual disability, in multiple studies; however, the results differed by cancer types and sex. In summary, these findings suggest an altered risk of cancer among individuals with mental illness living in Nordic countries. Further research is needed to enable the development of targeted cancer prevention strategies to reduce mental health disparities in cancer protection.
papers.title_zh: 精神疾病患者的癌症風險：北歐登錄資料前瞻性研究的系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 雖然癌症患者承受高度的精神疾病負擔，但精神疾病患者的癌症風險是否高於預期，目前仍較不清楚。本系統性回顧探討多種類型精神疾病與後續癌症風險之間的關聯。我們搜尋五個電子資料庫，納入自各資料庫建置起至2024年10月24日發表的文章。納入研究須使用北歐全國性登錄資料，前瞻性分析精神疾病診斷與癌症發生率之間的關聯。針對特定精神疾病類型，若至少有三個國家的資料，則進行隨機效應統合分析；否則進行敘述性整合。共篩選7,767篇不重複文章，其中20篇符合納入條件。統合分析顯示，思覺失調症診斷與整體癌症風險無關；然而，研究間存在高度異質性。相較於一般人口，思覺失調症患者似乎有較高的乳癌風險（合併標準化發生比［SIR］：1.28，95%信賴區間［CI］：1.08–1.52），以及較低的直腸癌風險（合併SIR：0.75，95% CI：0.59–0.95）與攝護腺癌風險（合併SIR：0.53，95% CI：0.48–0.59）。多篇研究觀察到，情緒障礙、焦慮症、壓力相關疾患、自閉症及智能障礙患者的整體癌症風險較高；然而，結果因癌症類型與性別而異。總而言之，這些發現顯示，居住於北歐國家的精神疾病患者，其癌症風險有所不同。仍需進一步研究，以協助制定針對性的癌症預防策略，減少癌症防護方面的心理健康差距。

papers.title: Robotic surgery in inflammatory bowel disease: a systematic review
papers.authors: Todescatto A, Mendes C, Araujo S, Kotze P
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Surgical treatment remains an essential component in the management of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) despite advances in medical therapy. Although minimally invasive surgery is preferred, technical challenges related to chronic inflammation and altered anatomy may limit laparoscopic approaches. Robotic surgery has been increasingly adopted, but its role in IBD surgery remains to be clearly defined.
OBJECTIVES: To synthesize the available evidence on the feasibility, safety, and perioperative outcomes of robotic surgery in patients with IBD.
METHODS: A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA guidelines. Studies were identified through an electronic search of the PubMed database for reports evaluating outcomes of robotic surgery in IBD. Eligible studies included case series, comparative studies, and systematic reviews published in English. Primary outcomes were conversion to open surgery and postoperative complications; secondary outcomes included operative time, length of stay (LOS), reoperation, readmission, and anastomotic leak.
RESULTS: Thirty-four studies were included. Robotic surgery was consistently associated with longer operative time. However, postoperative morbidity, major complications, anastomotic leak, reoperation, and mortality rates were comparable between techniques. Robotic approaches demonstrated lower and favorable conversion rates, particularly in complex inflammatory phenotypes or pelvic procedures. Length of stay and estimated blood loss were similar or numerically lower in several robotic cohorts.
CONCLUSION: Robotic surgery is a safe and feasible minimally invasive approach for IBD patients, with perioperative outcomes comparable to conventional surgery. Its potential advantages may be most relevant in complex or technically demanding cases, although high-quality prospective studies are needed to better define its role.

papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病的機器人手術：系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：儘管藥物治療已有進展，手術治療仍是發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）處置的重要一環。雖然微創手術是優先選擇，但慢性發炎與解剖構造改變所造成的技術挑戰，可能限制腹腔鏡手術的應用。機器人手術的採用日益增加，但其在IBD手術中的角色仍有待明確界定。
目的：整合現有證據，評估IBD病人接受機器人手術的可行性、安全性與圍手術期結果。
方法：依據PRISMA指引進行系統性回顧。透過PubMed資料庫的電子檢索，找出評估IBD機器人手術結果的文獻。納入以英文發表的病例系列、比較研究及系統性回顧。主要結果為轉開腹手術與術後併發症；次要結果包括手術時間、住院天數（LOS）、再次手術、再住院及吻合口滲漏。
結果：共納入34篇研究。機器人手術一致與較長的手術時間相關。然而，不同手術技術之間的術後罹病率、重大併發症、吻合口滲漏、再次手術及死亡率相近。機器人手術呈現較低且有利的轉開腹率，尤其是在複雜發炎表型或骨盆手術中。在數個機器人手術世代中，住院天數與估計失血量相近，或在數值上較低。
結論：機器人手術對IBD病人而言，是安全且可行的微創手術方式，其圍手術期結果與傳統手術相近。其潛在優勢可能在複雜或技術要求較高的病例中最具意義，但仍需要高品質前瞻性研究，以更清楚界定其角色。

papers.title: CRAT-mediated acetylcarnitine shuttling sustains p65 acetylation and NF-κB-associated radioresistance in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Liu Y, Xiao Y, Chen Y, Huang C, Lin F, Zhuang Q
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy is a standard treatment for locally advanced rectal cancer, yet acquired resistance limits durable tumor control. Whether stress-adaptive acetyl-group metabolism contributes to this resistance remains unclear.
METHODS: We performed a genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 loss-of-function screen under fractionated irradiation and integrated the results with transcriptomic and proteomic profiling of radioresistant colorectal cancer models established by stepwise irradiation. CRAT function was interrogated using genetic perturbation, catalytic-dead reconstitution, acetylation-mimetic p65 rescue, RELA depletion, stable-isotope tracing, free coenzyme A quantification, NF-κB reporter assays, chromatin immunoprecipitation-qPCR, and xenograft and syngeneic tumor models.
RESULTS: CRAT was prioritized through cross-platform convergence of the CRISPR screen with transcriptomic and proteomic signatures of radioresistant cells, and post-treatment tumors with poorer pathological regression showed higher CRAT and nuclear p65 immunohistochemical scores. CRAT manipulation had limited, model-dependent effects on basal proliferation but more pronounced effects after irradiation, where CRAT loss reduced clonogenic survival and was associated with increased oxidative stress and persistent DNA damage. Stable-isotope tracing showed that irradiation increased acetate-to-acetylcarnitine flux and expanded the free coenzyme A pool in control cells, whereas CRAT loss disrupted this acetyl-group buffering. Mechanistically, CRAT catalytic activity helped maintain irradiation-induced p65 Lys310 acetylation, H3K27ac enrichment at NF-κB-responsive loci, and NF-κB-associated transcriptional output through a p300/CBP-sensitive acetylation axis. p65-K310Q rescue and RELA depletion supported p65 acetylation and RELA-dependent transcription as downstream contributors to, rather than sole mediators of, CRAT-dependent radioprotection. In syngeneic MC38 tumors, Crat deletion enhanced the response to fractionated radiotherapy.
CONCLUSIONS: These findings support CRAT-dependent acetyl-group metabolism as a contributor to an NF-κB-associated radioprotective program and nominate this metabolic dependency as a candidate vulnerability for radiosensitization in colorectal cancer.
papers.title_zh: CRAT介導的乙醯肉鹼穿梭維持p65乙醯化及大腸直腸癌中與NF-κB相關的放射抗性
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：新輔助化學放射治療是局部晚期直腸癌的標準治療，但後天產生的抗性限制了持久的腫瘤控制。壓力適應性的乙醯基代謝是否參與此抗性，仍不清楚。
方法：我們在分次照射條件下進行全基因組CRISPR-Cas9功能喪失篩選，並將結果與透過逐步照射建立的放射抗性大腸直腸癌模型之轉錄體及蛋白質體分析整合。我們使用基因擾動、催化失活型重建、模擬乙醯化的p65救援實驗、RELA耗減、穩定同位素追蹤、游離輔酶A定量、NF-κB報導基因分析、染色質免疫沉澱-qPCR，以及異種移植與同系腫瘤模型，探究CRAT的功能。
結果：CRISPR篩選與放射抗性細胞的轉錄體及蛋白質體特徵在跨平台分析中匯聚，使CRAT被優先選為研究標的；而治療後病理退縮較差的腫瘤，其CRAT與核內p65免疫組織化學評分較高。操控CRAT對基礎增殖的影響有限，且依模型而異，但照射後的影響較明顯：CRAT缺失降低了集落形成存活能力，並與氧化壓力增加及持續性DNA損傷相關。穩定同位素追蹤顯示，照射使對照細胞中由乙酸流向乙醯肉鹼的代謝通量增加，並擴大游離輔酶A池；CRAT缺失則破壞了此乙醯基緩衝作用。在機制上，CRAT的催化活性透過對p300/CBP敏感的乙醯化軸，有助於維持照射誘發的p65 Lys310乙醯化、NF-κB反應性基因座的H3K27ac富集，以及與NF-κB相關的轉錄輸出。p65-K310Q救援與RELA耗減實驗支持，p65乙醯化及RELA依賴性轉錄是CRAT依賴性放射保護作用的下游貢獻因素，而非唯一介導因素。在同系MC38腫瘤中，Crat剔除增強了對分次放射治療的反應。
結論：這些發現支持CRAT依賴性乙醯基代謝是與NF-κB相關之放射保護程式的貢獻因素，並提出此代謝依賴性可能是大腸直腸癌放射增敏的候選弱點。

papers.title: Network Analysis of Symptoms and Comorbidity in Patients With Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer: Comparison With Late-Onset Colorectal Cancer
papers.authors: Yu J, Park J, Yun Y, Song N, Shin A, Kim M
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Patients with early-onset colorectal cancer (EOCRC) experience various symptoms and comorbidities throughout the treatment continuum. Identifying the intricate relationship between symptoms and comorbidities in EOCRC can provide a deeper understanding of the underlying mechanisms that shape the patient's entire experience. This study aimed to compare the association between symptoms and comorbidities in patients by age of onset to identify key relationships between symptoms and comorbid disease in EOCRC.
METHODS: Data of 985 patients enrolled in a prospective colorectal cancer (CRC) cohort between 2013 and 2021 in the Republic of Korea were analyzed. At baseline, patients were assessed for 33 symptoms and functions, as well as 14 comorbidities, and were subsequently stratified into two age groups: <50 (EOCRC) and ≥50 years (late-onset CRC [LOCRC]). Symptoms and comorbidity relationships were examined using correlation-based network analysis.
RESULTS: In total, 13.5% of the participants had EOCRC. In the EOCRC group, 44 patients (33.1%) had existing comorbidities. The symptom and comorbidity networks were more complex in EOCRC than in LOCRC. Fatigue was a central symptom in both age groups. The EOCRC group exhibited positive correlations between musculoskeletal disease and psychiatric disorder, stool frequency, and multiple symptoms. The LOCRC group showed pronounced correlations between embarrassment by bowel movement and multiple symptoms and between health functioning parameters and fatigue.
CONCLUSION: Cancer-related fatigue was an important feature in both groups. These findings underscore the importance of considering these factors to enhance quality-of-life care outcomes during and after CRC treatment.

papers.abstract_zh:
目的：早發型大腸直腸癌（EOCRC）患者在整個治療歷程中會經歷各種症狀與共病。辨識EOCRC中症狀與共病之間的複雜關係，可更深入了解形塑患者整體經驗的潛在機制。本研究旨在依發病年齡比較患者症狀與共病之間的關聯，以辨識EOCRC中症狀與共病疾病之間的關鍵關係。
方法：分析韓國於2013至2021年間納入一項前瞻性大腸直腸癌（CRC）世代研究的985名患者資料。於基線評估患者的33項症狀與功能，以及14項共病，隨後依年齡分為兩組：小於50歲（EOCRC）與大於或等於50歲（晚發型CRC［LOCRC］）。使用以相關性為基礎的網絡分析，探討症狀與共病之間的關係。
結果：全部參與者中，13.5%為EOCRC。在EOCRC組中，44名患者（33.1%）有既存共病。EOCRC的症狀與共病網絡比LOCRC更複雜。疲倦在兩個年齡組中皆為核心症狀。EOCRC組顯示，肌肉骨骼疾病與精神疾病、排便頻率及多項症狀呈正相關。LOCRC組則顯示，因排便而感到尷尬與多項症狀之間，以及健康功能參數與疲倦之間，具有明顯相關性。
結論：癌症相關疲倦是兩組的重要特徵。這些發現凸顯，在CRC治療期間及治療後，將這些因素納入考量，對改善生活品質照護結果的重要性。

papers.title: Pathobiont-directed mucosal immunotherapy targets Ruminococcus gnavus and remodels host-microbiota interactions in colitis
papers.authors: Wang Z, Huang L, Liu X, Cheng X, Liang Y, Chen J
papers.abstract: Disease-associated pathobionts are recurrently enriched in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), yet their causal contribution and selective therapeutic control remain incompletely defined. Here, through clinical microbiome profiling and causal animal studies, we identified Ruminococcus gnavus (Rg) as a key ulcerative colitis (UC)-associated pathobiont whose abundance positively correlates with intestinal oxidative stress and inflammatory levels. To selectively constrain Rg, we engineered CP-EV@Ca, an oral microbiota-directed mucosal immunotherapy that combines pathogen-specific immune targeting with redox modulation. CP-EV@Ca enhanced mucosal antigen presentation, promoted T follicular helper cell-germinal-center B-cell responses and induced robust Rg-specific secretory IgA (sIgA). CP-EV@Ca-induced mucosal immune responses, including enhanced Rg-specific sIgA production, were associated with increased immune coating and reduced Rg expansion. In both acute and chronic colitis models, CP-EV@Ca outperformed 5-aminosalicylic acid (5-ASA), suppressing inflammation and restoring microbial, epithelial and immune homeostasis. These findings demonstrate that pathobiont-specific mucosal immunity can be harnessed to selectively constrain disease-associated bacteria and restore intestinal homeostasis.

papers.abstract_zh: 疾病相關的致病共生菌在發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）中反覆呈現富集，然而其因果性貢獻及選擇性治療控制仍未完全釐清。本研究透過臨床微生物群分析與探討因果關係的動物研究，辨識出 Ruminococcus gnavus（Rg）為與潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）相關的關鍵致病共生菌，其豐度與腸道氧化壓力及發炎程度呈正相關。為選擇性限制 Rg，我們開發了 CP-EV@Ca，這是一種以微生物群為導向的口服黏膜免疫治療，結合病原菌特異性免疫靶向作用與氧化還原調節。CP-EV@Ca 增強黏膜抗原呈現，促進濾泡輔助型 T 細胞－生發中心 B 細胞反應，並誘發強烈的 Rg 特異性分泌型 IgA（sIgA）反應。CP-EV@Ca 所誘發的黏膜免疫反應，包括增加 Rg 特異性 sIgA 生成，與免疫包覆增加及 Rg 擴增減少相關。在急性與慢性結腸炎模型中，CP-EV@Ca 的表現均優於 5-胺基水楊酸（5-ASA），可抑制發炎，並恢復微生物群、上皮與免疫恆定。這些發現顯示，可利用致病共生菌特異性黏膜免疫，選擇性限制疾病相關細菌，並恢復腸道恆定。

papers.title: The Interplay Between Obesity, Gut Microbiota and Early-onset Colorectal Cancer
papers.authors: Kendong S, Razali N, Bo M, Sarkawi M, Mokhtar M, Hamid A
papers.abstract: The global incidence of colorectal cancer (CRC) is rising at an alarming rate, particularly among individuals under the age of 50, referred to as early-onset CRC (EOCRC). While genetic predisposition accounts for approximately 20% of the total cases, the majority are influenced by environmental and lifestyle factors. Among these, the rising prevalence of obesity is a major modifiable contributor to EOCRC pathogenesis. This narrative review explores the multifaceted role of obesity in EOCRC, focusing on how diet-induced adiposity reshapes the gut microbiota and host metabolic signaling. We synthesize evidence on how obesity-associated dysbiosis, characterized by the depletion of protective, short-chain fatty acid (SCFA)-producing bacteria and the enrichment of genotoxic pathobionts, compromises intestinal barrier integrity and promotes a "leaky gut" phenotype. In addition, we explore the systemic consequences of obesity-driven inflammation, including M1-polarized macrophage infiltration into adipose tissue, dysregulated adipokine signaling, and the hyperactivation of the insulin-IGF-1 axis. By integrating epidemiological data with molecular mechanisms, this review highlights how the synergy between metabolic dysfunction and microbial alterations creates a fertile niche for early-onset carcinogenesis. These findings underscore the importance of targeting lifestyle interventions to mitigate the rising burden of obesity and reduce the risk of EOCRC progression.

papers.title_zh: 肥胖、腸道微生物群與早發性大腸直腸癌之間的交互作用
papers.abstract_zh: 全球大腸直腸癌（CRC）的發生率正以令人憂心的速度上升，尤其是在50歲以下族群，此類病例稱為早發性大腸直腸癌（EOCRC）。雖然遺傳易感性約占全部病例的20%，但多數病例受到環境與生活型態因素影響。其中，肥胖盛行率上升是EOCRC致病過程中一項重要且可改變的促成因素。本敘述性綜述探討肥胖在EOCRC中的多重角色，著重於飲食誘發的脂肪堆積如何重塑腸道微生物群與宿主代謝訊號傳遞。我們整合相關證據，說明肥胖相關菌相失衡如何損害腸道屏障完整性並促成「腸漏」表型；這種菌相失衡的特徵，是具有保護作用、可產生短鏈脂肪酸（SCFA）的細菌減少，以及具有基因毒性的潛在致病共生菌增加。此外，我們探討肥胖所驅動之發炎的全身性後果，包括M1極化巨噬細胞浸潤脂肪組織、脂肪激素訊號傳遞失調，以及胰島素–IGF-1軸過度活化。透過整合流行病學資料與分子機轉，本綜述強調代謝功能失調與微生物變化之間的協同作用，如何為早發性致癌過程創造有利的微環境。這些發現凸顯針對生活型態進行介入的重要性，以減輕日益增加的肥胖負擔，並降低EOCRC進展的風險。

papers.title: Mechanisms and therapeutic perspectives of mucosal glycosylation-innate immunity crosstalk in inflammatory bowel disease (Review)
papers.authors: Liu X, Zhang T, Jin J, Song Y, Li M, Zhong H
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a group of chronic, relapsing inflammatory disorders of the gastrointestinal tract, driven by a complex interplay of genetic susceptibility, environmental exposures, intestinal microbiota dysbiosis and immune dysregulation. In recent years, mucosal glycosylation has emerged as a fundamental molecular determinant of intestinal barrier integrity and function and is increasingly recognized as a key regulatory interface linking the microbiota with host immune responses. Concurrently, the innate immune system serves an important role in mucosal defense and inflammatory responses through pattern recognition receptor‑mediated signaling, and its aberrant activation represents a key driver of persistent inflammation in IBD. The present review systematically summarizes the bidirectional regulatory crosstalk between mucosal glycosylation and innate immunity. The mechanistic roles of glycosylation modifications are highlighted in pathogen recognition, inflammatory signal transduction, inflammasome activation and maintenance of mucosal barrier integrity. Conversely, it is discussed how innate immune activation regulates glycan biosynthesis and remodeling through inflammatory cytokines, oxidative stress and major signaling pathways, thereby reshaping the mucosal glycome in disease contexts. On this basis, the dynamic alterations of glycosylation‑innate immunity interactions across different stages of IBD, including disease initiation, progression and relapse, are delineated, emphasizing their important role in sustaining chronic inflammation and driving tissue remodeling. In addition, emerging therapeutic strategies targeting glycosylation pathways, glycan‑lectin interactions, mucosal barrier restoration and microbiota modulation are summarized. The potential of glycomics, multi‑omics integration and glyco‑immune biomarkers in disease stratification and precision medicine are also discussed. By integrating perspectives from glycobiology and immunology, the present review aims to provide a conceptual framework and novel directions for mechanistic research and targeted therapy in IBD.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）是一組胃腸道慢性、反覆發作的發炎性疾病，由遺傳易感性、環境暴露、腸道菌相失衡及免疫失調之間的複雜交互作用所驅動。近年來，黏膜糖基化已成為決定腸道屏障完整性與功能的基礎分子因素，並日益被認為是連結微生物群與宿主免疫反應的重要調控介面。同時，先天性免疫系統透過模式辨識受體介導的訊息傳遞，在黏膜防禦與發炎反應中扮演重要角色，而其異常活化則是IBD持續發炎的重要驅動因素。本綜述有系統地彙整黏膜糖基化與先天性免疫之間的雙向調控交互作用。本文著重說明糖基化修飾在病原體辨識、發炎訊息傳遞、發炎小體活化，以及維持黏膜屏障完整性中的機制性角色。反過來，本文也討論先天性免疫活化如何透過發炎細胞激素、氧化壓力及主要訊息傳遞路徑，調控聚醣的生合成與重塑，進而在疾病情境下重塑黏膜聚醣體。在此基礎上，本文描繪糖基化與先天性免疫交互作用在IBD不同階段，包括疾病起始、進展及復發期間的動態變化，強調其在維持慢性發炎及驅動組織重塑中的重要角色。此外，本文彙整針對糖基化路徑、聚醣與凝集素交互作用、黏膜屏障修復及微生物群調節的新興治療策略。本文亦討論聚醣體學、多體學整合及糖基化－免疫生物標記在疾病分層與精準醫療中的潛力。透過整合醣生物學與免疫學的觀點，本綜述旨在為IBD機制研究與標靶治療提供概念架構及新方向。

papers.title: AI-facilitated individualized nutritional guidance with ABC-structured prompts improves short-term dietary intake adequacy and patient-reported symptoms after gastrointestinal cancer surgery: a randomized controlled trial
papers.journal_full: Supportive care in cancer : official journal of the Multinational Association of Supportive Care in Cancer
papers.authors: Chen H, Jiang W, Li M, Zhang S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Postoperative nutritional management is critical for gastrointestinal cancer surgery patients, yet discharge advice is often standardized and lacks individualization. Whether an AI-facilitated individualized and quantified strategy improves short-term dietary intake compared with standard generic advice remains unclear; this trial does not isolate the independent effect of AI.
OBJECTIVE: To determine whether AI-facilitated individualized nutritional guidance using structured prompts improves short-term dietary intake adequacy and patient-reported symptoms versus standard discharge advice.
METHODS: In this single-center, randomized controlled trial, 90 patients undergoing laparoscopic gastric or colorectal cancer surgery were assigned 1:1 to AI-facilitated individualized guidance generated by DeepSeek v3.2 using an ABC-structured prompt plus clinician review or standard discharge dietary advice (standard care group). The intervention combined AI, individualization, quantified targets, written guidance, and clinician review; the trial cannot isolate AI alone. Primary outcome was energy intake adequacy (≥ 90% of target) at 30 days post-discharge. Secondary outcomes included protein intake adequacy, nutritional status, patient-reported outcomes, process measures (expert-rated quality scores, provider time), and 30-day complications. Outcome assessors were blinded to group assignment.
RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were well-balanced between groups. The AI-guided group achieved significantly higher energy adequacy (66.7% vs. 40.0%, OR 3.0, 95% CI 1.3-7.1, P = 0.01) and protein adequacy (62.2% vs. 35.6%, OR 2.9, 95% CI 1.2-6.8, P = 0.01) at 30 days. Expert-rated quality scores were superior in the AI-guided group for completeness (4.6 vs. 3.2), individualization (4.8 vs. 2.8), and actionability (4.5 vs. 3.5) (all P < 0.001), while provider time per patient was reduced (8.2 vs. 12.5 min, P < 0.001). Patient-reported outcomes showed significant improvements in fatigue, nausea/vomiting, appetite loss, and gastrointestinal symptoms (GSRS total score 2.1 vs. 2.5, P = 0.03) in the AI-guided group. No significant differences were observed in weight change, serum nutritional markers, or complication rates.
CONCLUSION: AI-facilitated individualized nutritional guidance improved short-term dietary intake adequacy and patient-reported symptoms and reduced provider time compared with standard generic advice. These findings do not show that AI itself is superior to similarly individualized non-AI counseling and do not establish longer-term nutritional or clinical benefit. Clinical supervision remains essential.

papers.title_zh: 採用ABC結構化提示詞的AI輔助個別化營養指導，可改善胃腸道癌症術後短期飲食攝取達標率與病人自陳症狀：隨機對照試驗
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：術後營養管理對接受胃腸道癌症手術的病人至關重要，但出院建議往往標準化，缺乏個別化。相較於標準的一般性建議，AI輔助的個別化、量化策略能否改善短期飲食攝取，仍不清楚；本試驗無法分離出AI的獨立效果。
目的：確定使用結構化提示詞的AI輔助個別化營養指導，相較於標準出院建議，能否改善短期飲食攝取達標率與病人自陳症狀。
方法：本單中心隨機對照試驗將90名接受腹腔鏡胃癌或大腸直腸癌手術的病人，以1:1分派接受AI輔助個別化指導，或標準出院飲食建議（標準照護組）。個別化指導由DeepSeek v3.2使用ABC結構化提示詞產生，並經臨床人員審核。介入結合AI、個別化、量化目標、書面指導及臨床人員審核；本試驗無法分離出AI本身的效果。主要結果為出院後30天的熱量攝取達標率（達到目標的≥90%）。次要結果包括蛋白質攝取達標率、營養狀態、病人自陳結果、流程指標（專家評定的品質分數、醫療提供者耗時），以及30天併發症。結果評估者對組別分派採盲法。
結果：兩組基線特徵均衡。30天時，AI指導組的熱量攝取達標率（66.7% vs. 40.0%，OR 3.0，95% CI 1.3–7.1，P=0.01）及蛋白質攝取達標率（62.2% vs. 35.6%，OR 2.9，95% CI 1.2–6.8，P=0.01）均顯著較高。AI指導組在專家評定的完整性（4.6 vs. 3.2）、個別化程度（4.8 vs. 2.8）及可執行性（4.5 vs. 3.5）品質分數上均較佳（皆P<0.001），同時每位病人的醫療提供者耗時較少（8.2 vs. 12.5分鐘，P<0.001）。病人自陳結果顯示，AI指導組的疲倦、噁心／嘔吐、食慾不振及胃腸道症狀均顯著改善（GSRS總分2.1 vs. 2.5，P=0.03）。體重變化、血清營養指標及併發症發生率均未觀察到顯著差異。
結論：相較於標準的一般性建議，AI輔助個別化營養指導改善了短期飲食攝取達標率及病人自陳症狀，並減少醫療提供者耗時。這些結果並未顯示AI本身優於同樣個別化的非AI諮詢，也未確立較長期的營養或臨床效益。臨床監督仍不可或缺。

papers.title: Efficacy and Safety of Short-Course Radiotherapy Alone or Combined With Consolidation Chemotherapy Versus Conventional Long-Course Chemoradiotherapy for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
papers.authors: Wang C, Han Y, Xue S, Liu K, Zhang Z, Li Y
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Short-course radiotherapy (SCRT)-based regimens, including SCRT-alone and SCRT-based total neoadjuvant therapy (SCRT-based TNT, defined as SCRT followed by consolidation chemotherapy), have emerged as alternative neoadjuvant options to long-course chemoradiotherapy (LCCRT) for locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC). This meta-analysis stratified analyses by the type of SCRT regimen and whether LCCRT arms received preoperative consolidation chemotherapy, to systematically compare their efficacy and safety and inform personalized treatment selection.
METHODS: A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and Web of Science identified randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing SCRT-based regimens and LCCRT up to November 2025. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment. Pooled analyses were conducted using Review Manager 5.3, with relative risk (RR) or hazard ratio (HR) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs).
RESULTS: Nine randomized trials (reported in 16 publications), involving 3,061 patients, were included. In the primary comparison of SCRT-based TNT versus standard LCCRT, the SCRT-based TNT group achieved a significantly higher pathological complete response rate (RR = 1.56, 95% CI: 1.24-1.97, P = 0.0002), whereas tumor downstaging and locoregional failure showed no significant differences from the LCCRT group. The SCRT-based TNT regimen was associated with a significantly higher incidence of grade ≥ 3 acute toxicity (RR = 1.63, 95% CI: 1.14-2.34, P = 0.008), and showed numerical trends toward improved overall survival (HR = 0.99, 95% CI: 0.76-1.28, P = 0.91) and disease-free survival (HR = 1.05, 95% CI: 0.77-1.43, P = 0.77) that did not reach statistical significance. SCRT alone was associated with lower pCR (RR = 0.13, 95% CI: 0.03-0.51, P = 0.003) and downstaging rates (RR = 0.66, 95% CI: 0.56-0.79, P < 0.00001) but a markedly lower incidence of acute toxicity (RR = 0.12, 95% CI: 0.05-0.29, P < 0.00001). An exploratory analysis based on a single small trial found no significant differences between SCRT-based TNT and LCCRT-based TNT across all major endpoints. Pooling all SCRT-based strategies obscured clinically meaningful heterogeneity and yielded no significant differences for any primary endpoint.
CONCLUSIONS: SCRT-based TNT significantly improves pCR compared with standard LCCRT but does not translate into survival benefit, with a numerical increase in locoregional failure. SCRT-alone offers lower acute toxicity but substantially poorer tumor response, warranting use only in selected patients. The comparison between SCRT-based TNT and LCCRT-based TNT remains inconclusive. SCRT-based regimens represent heterogeneous treatment pathways rather than a uniform substitute for LCCRT, requiring individualized clinical decision-making.

目的：以短程放射治療（SCRT）為基礎的療程，包括單獨SCRT及以SCRT為基礎的全程新輔助治療（SCRT-based TNT，定義為SCRT後接鞏固化療），已成為局部進展期直腸癌（LARC）除長程同步化放療（LCCRT）之外的新輔助治療選項。本統合分析依SCRT療程類型，以及LCCRT組是否接受術前鞏固化療進行分層分析，以系統性比較其療效與安全性，並提供個人化治療選擇的依據。
方法：系統性搜尋PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library及Web of Science，納入截至2025年11月比較SCRT為基礎療程與LCCRT的隨機對照試驗（RCT）。兩位審查者獨立進行研究篩選、資料擷取及偏誤風險評估。使用Review Manager 5.3進行合併分析，採用相對風險（RR）或危險比（HR）及其95%信賴區間（CI）。
結果：共納入9項隨機試驗（發表於16篇文獻），涉及3,061名病人。在SCRT-based TNT與標準LCCRT的主要比較中，SCRT-based TNT組達到顯著較高的病理完全緩解率（RR＝1.56，95% CI：1.24–1.97，P＝0.0002），但腫瘤降期及局部區域治療失敗與LCCRT組無顯著差異。SCRT-based TNT療程與顯著較高的第3級以上急性毒性發生率相關（RR＝1.63，95% CI：1.14–2.34，P＝0.008），整體存活（HR＝0.99，95% CI：0.76–1.28，P＝0.91）及無病存活（HR＝1.05，95% CI：0.77–1.43，P＝0.77）則呈現數值上改善的趨勢，但未達統計顯著。單獨SCRT與較低的pCR率（RR＝0.13，95% CI：0.03–0.51，P＝0.003）及降期率（RR＝0.66，95% CI：0.56–0.79，P＜0.00001）相關，但急性毒性發生率也明顯較低（RR＝0.12，95% CI：0.05–0.29，P＜0.00001）。一項基於單一小型試驗的探索性分析發現，SCRT-based TNT與LCCRT-based TNT在所有主要終點上均無顯著差異。合併所有以SCRT為基礎的策略，會掩蓋具有臨床意義的異質性，且所有主要終點均未呈現顯著差異。
結論：相較於標準LCCRT，SCRT-based TNT可顯著提高pCR，但未轉化為存活獲益，且局部區域治療失敗在數值上增加。單獨SCRT的急性毒性較低，但腫瘤反應明顯較差，因此僅應用於經篩選的病人。SCRT-based TNT與LCCRT-based TNT之間的比較仍無定論。以SCRT為基礎的療程代表具有異質性的治療路徑，而非可一致取代LCCRT的方案，需進行個別化臨床決策。

papers.title: Germline BRCA-Lynch syndrome MINAS: report of six Argentinian families and a systematic review of the literature
papers.authors: Alberto G, Tortosa F, Mansilla Figueroa M, Antelo M, Sanchez L, Norese G
papers.abstract: The co-occurrence of germline pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants (PVs) in BRCA1/BRCA2 and mismatch repair genes (Lynch Syndrome) (BRCA-LS) is an infrequent overlap of the two most frequent hereditary cancer syndromes. Recent reviews have examined whether the cancer risk profile in BRCA-LS carriers is independent for both syndromes or if both germline variants act as mutual modifying factors, including a synergistic effect. This study on BRCA-LS Multi-locus Inherited Neoplasia Allele Syndrome (MINAS) aims to report six affected families, perform a systematic review (SR) of the literature to identify previously reported patients, and analyze the phenotype of this genetic condition. Including the reported families and the patients retrieved by the SR (40 publications), 92 patients from 69 families were analyzed. The analysis of the BRCA-LS MINAS phenotype showed a balanced distribution of BRCA and LS-related tumor patterns and tumors outside the established BRCA or LS spectra were uncommon. Carriers of PVs in MLH1 and MSH2/EPCAM were more likely to be diagnosed with ≥ 2 tumors [OR 3.60-95% CI 1.29-10.55; p = 0.0095] and with extracolonic tumors [OR 3,28 (CI95 1,26-8,84) p =0.0089] than carriers of PVs in MSH6 and PMS2, findings that are consistent with known genotype-phenotype correlations in LS. Our findings suggest that in the context of clinically ascertained patients with a personal or family history of cancer, BRCA-LS MINAS is primarily characterized by the independent expression of both syndromes and that potential synergistic effects require further evaluation in studies including systematically ascertained patients.

papers.title_zh: 生殖細胞系 BRCA–Lynch 症候群 MINAS：六個阿根廷家族報告與文獻系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh: BRCA1／BRCA2 與錯配修復基因（Lynch 症候群）的生殖細胞系致病性或可能致病性變異（PVs）同時存在（BRCA-LS），是兩種最常見遺傳性癌症症候群的罕見重疊。近期綜述探討了 BRCA-LS 帶因者的癌症風險型態，究竟是兩種症候群各自獨立表現，或是兩個生殖細胞系變異會互相修飾其效應，包括產生協同作用。本研究針對 BRCA-LS 多基因座遺傳性腫瘤等位基因症候群（Multi-locus Inherited Neoplasia Allele Syndrome，MINAS），旨在報告六個受影響家族、進行文獻系統性回顧（SR）以找出先前報告的病人，並分析此遺傳狀況的表現型。納入本次報告的家族及系統性回顧所找到的病人（40 篇文獻）後，共分析來自 69 個家族的 92 名病人。BRCA-LS MINAS 表現型分析顯示，BRCA 與 LS 相關腫瘤型態的分布均衡，而不屬於既定 BRCA 或 LS 腫瘤範圍的腫瘤並不常見。相較於 MSH6 與 PMS2 致病性或可能致病性變異帶因者，MLH1 與 MSH2／EPCAM 變異帶因者較可能被診斷出 ≥2 個腫瘤［OR 3.60，95% CI 1.29–10.55；p＝0.0095］及大腸以外腫瘤［OR 3.28，95% CI 1.26–8.84；p＝0.0089］；這些發現與已知的 LS 基因型－表現型關聯一致。我們的研究結果提示，在因個人或家族癌症病史而於臨床被辨識的病人中，BRCA-LS MINAS 主要呈現兩種症候群各自獨立的表現；潛在協同作用仍須透過納入系統性辨識個案的研究進一步評估。

papers.title: Advances in immunotherapy for gastrointestinal malignancies
papers.authors: Liu B, Wang L, Ma Y, Xu W, Chen X, Chi Z
papers.abstract: Gastrointestinal malignancies remain leading causes of cancer mortality, yet their sensitivity to immunotherapy differs sharply across anatomical sites, histologies, molecular subtypes, and disease stages. Immune checkpoint blockade has established durable clinical benefit in microsatellite instability-high colorectal cancer, advanced gastric and esophageal cancers, hepatocellular carcinoma, and biliary tract cancer, while pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer remain largely refractory. Recent phase III trials have moved immunotherapy into perioperative treatment. Concurrently, claudin 18.2-directed chimeric antigen receptor T cells, T-cell receptor-engineered cells, bispecific antibodies, personalized vaccines, and oncolytic viruses are converting previously speculative strategies into clinically testable platforms. This review integrates contemporary trial evidence with mechanisms of immune escape, biomarker development, and combination toxicity. The resulting framework prioritizes evidence maturity across diverse gastrointestinal tumor types worldwide.

papers.title: Imaging and Complications of Meckel Diverticulum
papers.journal_full: Radiographics : a review publication of the Radiological Society of North America, Inc
papers.authors: Panda A, Farah A, Itani M, Shaikh M, Rostislav R, Jain A
papers.abstract: Meckel diverticulum is the most common congenital anomaly of the gastrointestinal tract, yet it is frequently asymptomatic. Meckel diverticulum poses unique diagnostic challenges due to its variable manifestation and infrequent visualization at imaging. The authors review the embryology and anatomy of Meckel diverticulum, its normal radiologic appearances, and its complications and their management. Complications of Meckel diverticulum occur in up to 4%-9% of patients. Symptomatic Meckel diverticulum is more common in children but can also be seen in adults. A giant Meckel diverticulum, presence of ectopic gastric or pancreatic tissue, or adjacent adhesions and bands are associated with a higher likelihood of a symptomatic manifestation. The most common complications include small-bowel obstruction, gastrointestinal bleeding, and diverticulitis. Children more commonly present with gastrointestinal bleeding, while diverticulitis is more common in adults. Small-bowel obstruction can occur at any age and can be secondary to inversion of Meckel diverticulum, intussusception, volvulus, internal or external hernias, neoplasms, enteroliths, congenital bands, or postinflammatory changes. When a patient presents with acute abdomen or gastrointestinal bleeding, the choice of imaging modalities includes CT or US, with the latter preferred in the pediatric population. Technetium 99m-pertechnetate scintigraphy (Meckel scan) can be additionally performed to evaluate rectal bleeding in younger patients. MRI is reserved as a problem-solving tool. Meckel diverticulum should be differentiated from its common imaging mimics (eg, the appendix, ileal duplication cyst, and mesenteric small-bowel diverticulum). When Meckel diverticulum is not visualized at imaging, the radiologist still plays a key role by raising suspicion for an underlying Meckel diverticulum and identifying other critical imaging findings that can inform clinical management. An understanding of the common clinical manifestations associated with Meckel diverticulum and a systematic imaging approach can improve preoperative diagnosis and patient management.

papers.abstract_zh: 美克爾憩室是胃腸道最常見的先天性異常，但經常沒有症狀。由於臨床表現多變，且影像檢查不常能顯示美克爾憩室，其診斷面臨獨特的挑戰。作者回顧美克爾憩室的胚胎學與解剖學、正常放射影像表現，以及其併發症與處置。美克爾憩室患者發生併發症的比例可達 4%–9%。有症狀的美克爾憩室較常見於兒童，但成人也可能出現。巨大美克爾憩室、異位胃組織或胰臟組織的存在，以及鄰近的沾黏與帶狀結構，均與較高的症狀發生可能性相關。最常見的併發症包括小腸阻塞、胃腸道出血及憩室炎。兒童較常以胃腸道出血表現，成人則較常出現憩室炎。小腸阻塞可發生於任何年齡，並可繼發於美克爾憩室內翻、腸套疊、腸扭轉、內疝或外疝、腫瘤、腸石、先天性帶狀結構或發炎後變化。當患者以急腹症或胃腸道出血就醫時，可選擇的影像檢查包括 CT 或超音波，兒童族群則優先選擇後者。對於較年輕患者的直腸出血，亦可加做鎝-99m 過鎝酸鹽閃爍攝影（Meckel scan）進行評估。MRI 則保留作為釐清疑難診斷的工具。美克爾憩室應與影像上常見的相似病灶區別，例如闌尾、迴腸重複囊腫及腸繫膜側小腸憩室。即使影像未顯示美克爾憩室，放射科醫師仍扮演關鍵角色，可藉由提出潛在美克爾憩室的疑慮，並辨識其他能協助臨床處置的重要影像發現，提供診療方向。了解美克爾憩室常見的相關臨床表現，並採用系統性的影像評估方式，可改善術前診斷與病人照護。

papers.title: Wearable Technologies in Gastrointestinal Disorders: Current Evidence and Future Directions
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Gastrointestinal disorders fluctuate between clinical encounters, creating a need for objective longitudinal monitoring. We review wearable technologies across gastrointestinal disorders, emphasizing clinical applications, current evidence, and barriers to implementation.
RECENT FINDINGS: Wearables capture physiologic, biochemical, and acoustic signals relevant to gastrointestinal disease. In inflammatory bowel disease, wearable-derived physiologic changes may precede inflammatory and symptomatic flares and help distinguish inflammatory from non-inflammatory symptoms. Sweat biosensors can measure inflammatory analytes, including calprotectin. Beyond inflammatory bowel disease, autonomic measures characterize disorders of gut-brain interaction, electrogastrographic and acoustic devices assess gastrointestinal motility, and activity and sleep metrics may aid postoperative recovery assessment and risk stratification in chronic liver disease. Evidence remains predominantly observational, and validated clinical thresholds are lacking, limiting the current clinical applicability of wearable derived signals. Wearables enable continuous, noninvasive monitoring across gastrointestinal disorders, but prospective trials are needed to establish clinical utility, actionable thresholds, workflow integration, and patient-centered implementation, and demonstrate improvement in clinically meaningful outcomes.

papers.title: Advanced Anal Squamous Cell Carcinoma in the Chemoimmunotherapy Era: Retifanlimab, Nivolumab, and a Practical Framework for Treatment Selection
papers.authors: Sagawa T, Hirakawa M, Nagashima H, Fujikawa K
papers.abstract: Advanced anal squamous cell carcinoma (ASCC) is a rare human papillomavirus-associated malignancy with historically limited prospective evidence for systemic therapy. InterAAct established carboplatin-paclitaxel as a clinically favorable chemotherapy backbone compared with cisplatin-fluorouracil. POD1UM-303/InterAACT-2 subsequently showed that adding retifanlimab significantly improved progression-free survival in patients with no prior systemic therapy for advanced disease. At the final overall-survival analysis, median overall survival was 32.8 versus 22.2 months (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.55-1.01); the regimen has received regulatory authorization in the United States, the European Union, and Japan. EA2176 is evaluating carboplatin-paclitaxel with or without nivolumab and will clarify whether first-line PD-1-based chemoimmunotherapy represents a reproducible class effect. This focused narrative review critically summarizes the evidence for retifanlimab- and nivolumab-based strategies and proposes a practical framework for treatment selection. Key considerations include performance status, immune-checkpoint-inhibitor eligibility, HIV infection, autoimmune risk, neuropathy, organ function, tumor burden, local symptom control, and post-chemoimmunotherapy sequencing. Retifanlimab plus carboplatin-paclitaxel currently has the most mature phase III evidence, whereas nivolumab-based chemoimmunotherapy remains investigational pending EA2176. Treatment decisions should distinguish phase III-validated options from class-effect extrapolation and integrate multidisciplinary local therapy when appropriate.

papers.abstract_zh: 晚期肛門鱗狀上皮細胞癌（ASCC）是一種與人類乳突病毒相關的罕見惡性腫瘤，過去支持其全身性治療的前瞻性證據有限。InterAAct 確立了 carboplatin-paclitaxel 相較於 cisplatin-fluorouracil，是臨床上較有利的化療骨幹。其後，POD1UM-303/InterAACT-2 顯示，對於先前未曾因晚期疾病接受全身性治療的病人，加入 retifanlimab 可顯著改善無惡化存活期。在最終整體存活分析中，中位整體存活期為 32.8 個月對 22.2 個月（HR 0.75，95% CI 0.55–1.01）；此療程已在美國、歐盟及日本取得監管核准。EA2176 正在評估 carboplatin-paclitaxel 合併或不合併 nivolumab，將釐清以 PD-1 抑制劑為基礎的一線化學免疫治療，是否具有可重現的類別效應。本篇聚焦式敘述性綜述批判性地整理以 retifanlimab 與 nivolumab 為基礎之治療策略的證據，並提出實用的治療選擇架構。重要考量包括體能狀態、免疫檢查點抑制劑的使用適格性、HIV 感染、自體免疫風險、周邊神經病變、器官功能、腫瘤負荷、局部症狀控制，以及化學免疫治療後的治療序列。目前，retifanlimab 合併 carboplatin-paclitaxel 具有最成熟的第三期試驗證據，而以 nivolumab 為基礎的化學免疫治療，在等待 EA2176 結果期間仍屬研究性治療。治療決策應區分經第三期試驗驗證的選項與類別效應的外推，並在適當時整合多專科局部治療。

papers.title: Temporal patterns and influencing factors associated with low anterior resection syndrome after rectal cancer surgery: A scoping review
papers.journal_full: The Journal of international medical research
papers.authors: He S, Chang Y, Gao L, Zhao F, Shi J, Ma J
papers.abstract: ObjectivesTo map the existing evidence on the evolution of low anterior resection syndrome, including factors associated with stage-specific low anterior resection syndrome outcomes and longitudinal changes in symptoms.MethodsThis scoping review was conducted in accordance with the Joanna Briggs Institute methodology and reported following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews guideline. Seven databases were searched through 31 December 2025, with English databases searched from 1 January 2012 and Chinese databases from 1 January 2013. Eligible studies included adults aged ≥18 years who underwent sphincter-preserving anterior resection for rectal cancer and were diagnosed with low anterior resection syndrome at least twice postoperatively.ResultsTwenty-three studies were included. Major low anterior resection syndrome was most prevalent during the early follow-up period, particularly at approximately 1-3 months. Symptom improvement was most evident between 6 and 18 months, whereas overall symptom patterns tended to stabilize after approximately 18-24 months, with relatively limited changes subsequently up to 36 months. Tumor and anastomotic location, surgical approach, radiotherapy and/or chemotherapy, and stoma-related factors were associated with low anterior resection syndrome at different follow-up stages or with longitudinal symptom changes. However, only a few studies directly examined longitudinal changes or trajectory-related factors.ConclusionLow anterior resection syndrome is a dynamic condition with stage-specific patterns and substantial inter-individual variability. Understanding its temporal evolution and associated factors may help identify high-risk patients, optimize the timing of assessment, and tailor supportive care and rehabilitation across recovery stages. However, heterogeneity in study design, follow-up schedules, and outcome measures limits comparability. Future research should adopt standardized longitudinal designs, harmonized follow-up protocols, larger samples, and more comprehensive assessment tools to strengthen evidence for individualized low anterior resection syndrome management.

papers.title_zh: 直腸癌手術後低位前切除症候群（LARS）的時間變化模式與相關影響因素：範疇性回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：描繪低位前切除症候群（LARS）演變的現有證據，包括與不同階段LARS結果及症狀縱向變化相關的因素。方法：本範疇性回顧依循Joanna Briggs Institute方法學進行，並按照系統性回顧與統合分析優先報告項目之範疇性回顧延伸指引（PRISMA-ScR）報告。檢索七個資料庫，截止日期為2025年12月31日；英文資料庫自2012年1月1日起搜尋，中文資料庫則自2013年1月1日起搜尋。符合資格的研究納入年齡≥18歲、因直腸癌接受保留括約肌之前位切除術，且術後至少兩次被診斷為LARS的成人。結果：共納入23篇研究。重度LARS在早期追蹤期間最常見，尤其約在1–3個月時。症狀改善以6–18個月之間最明顯，而整體症狀模式約於18–24個月後趨於穩定，此後至36個月的變化相對有限。腫瘤與吻合口位置、手術方式、放射治療及／或化學治療，以及造口相關因素，與不同追蹤階段的LARS或症狀縱向變化有關。然而，直接探討縱向變化或症狀軌跡相關因素的研究僅有少數。結論：LARS是一種動態變化的狀況，具有階段特異性的模式，且個體間差異相當大。了解其時間演變與相關因素，可能有助於辨識高風險病人、優化評估時機，並依不同恢復階段調整支持性照護與復健。然而，研究設計、追蹤時程與結果測量的異質性限制了研究間的可比較性。未來研究應採用標準化縱向設計、一致的追蹤方案、更大的樣本，以及更全面的評估工具，以強化個別化LARS管理的證據。

papers.title: Recent Progress in HDAC-Based Dual-Target Inhibitors for Colorectal Cancer
papers.authors: Yang J, Shi X, Xu Y, Kong Q, Kong D, Feng Y
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related incidence and mortality worldwide, with accumulating evidence indicating that its tumorigenesis and progression are tightly linked to epigenetic dysregulation. Histone deacetylases (HDACs) are key epigenetic regulators involved in gene transcription, cell-cycle regulation, and cancer progression, whereas the therapeutic benefits of conventional HDAC inhibitors are frequently compromised by limited selectivity and resistance development. Recently, dual-target HDAC inhibitors (HDACis) have attracted considerable attention as an emerging paradigm in anticancer drug development. These multitarget strategies can simultaneously enhance synergistic antitumor efficacy and alleviate the compensatory resistance commonly associated with single-target therapies via multi-mechanistic interventions. Accordingly, the concurrent modulation of HDACs and additional therapeutic targets represents a viable therapeutic strategy for CRC. In this review, we systematically summarize the recent progress of dual-target HDAC is in CRC treatment, with particular emphasis on their therapeutic potential and implications for future translational research and clinical practice.

papers.title_zh: 用於大腸直腸癌的 HDAC 雙靶點抑制劑：近期進展
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）仍是全球癌症發生與死亡的主要原因之一，且日益累積的證據顯示，其腫瘤形成與進展與表觀遺傳失調密切相關。組蛋白去乙醯化酶（HDACs）是參與基因轉錄、細胞週期調控及癌症進展的重要表觀遺傳調節因子；然而，傳統 HDAC 抑制劑的治療效益經常受到選擇性不足及抗藥性形成的限制。近年來，雙靶點 HDAC 抑制劑（HDACis）作為抗癌藥物開發的新興模式，已受到廣泛關注。這些多靶點策略可透過多重機制介入，同時增強協同抗腫瘤療效，並減輕單一靶點治療常見的代償性抗藥性。因此，同時調控 HDACs 與其他治療靶點，是 CRC 的一項可行治療策略。在本篇綜述中，我們有系統地總結雙靶點 HDAC 抑制劑用於 CRC 治療的近期進展，並特別著重其治療潛力，以及對未來轉譯研究與臨床實務的意涵。
